name: Indian National Congress
description: The Indian National Congress (INC) is one of India's oldest political parties. Founded in 1885, it played a central role in India's freedom movement and has led several Union Governments after independence.
achievements: Played a major role in India's freedom movement.
Led the first Government of independent India.
Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA).
Growth of the Information Technology sector during UPA years.
Introduction of Aadhaar during the UPA government.
criticisms: The Emergency period (1975–1977) remains one of the party's most debated decisions.
Corruption allegations during different periods in office.
Critics have questioned governance and policy implementation in various periods.
Internal leadership and organisational challenges have been discussed by political analysts.
protests: Participation in nationwide protests on economic and social issues while in opposition.
Public demonstrations on unemployment, inflation and agricultural issues.
majorSchemes: Jawaharlal Nehru National Urban Renewal Mission
timeline: 1947 - Led the first Government of independent India.
2009 - Re-elected to lead the UPA Government.
2024 - Improved Lok Sabha performance compared with 2019.

faqs.question: When was the Indian National Congress founded?
faqs.answer: The Indian National Congress was founded on 28 December 1885.

faqs.question: What is the election symbol of Congress?
Which alliance is Congress part of?
What role did Congress play in the freedom movement?
faqs.answer: The party was a principal political organisation in India's independence movement and included many prominent national leaders.
